n: Massimo 36 Inch Dual Fuel Range in with Air Fryer Basket, True Convection Oven, Matte Cast Iron Grates, and Antique Brass Handles
desc: The Massimo 36 inch dual fuel range delivers powerful performance with elevated style. It features six sealed gas burners and matte cast iron grates, plus included accessories like a wok ring and removable griddle.
hl: Six Sealed Gas Burners: Features 6 powerful sealed burners for efficient, easy-to-clean gas cooking.
Air Fryer Basket Included: Cook crispy meals with less oil using the built-in air fry function and included basket.
Matte Cast Iron Grates: Durable, heavy-duty grates support all cookware and hold up under high heat.
True Convection Cooking: 1500 watt convection fan ensures even heat distribution for faster, consistent baking and roasting.
36 Inch Dual Fuel Range: Combines a gas cooktop with an electric convection oven for precise, versatile cooking performance.
Removable Griddle and Wok Support: Versatile cooktop accessories let you sear, sauté, and stir-fry with ease.
